issue: Does 18 U.S.C. § 666(a)(2) criminalize only quid pro quo bribery, or also gratuities given to local officials without any reciprocal exchange?

sides.position: Section 666(a)(2) reaches only quid pro quo bribery; a gratuity without a reciprocal exchange is not covered.
cases: United States v. Hamilton, 62 F.4th 167 (5th Cir. 2023)

sides.position: Section 666(a)(2) also criminalizes gratuities to local officials even in the absence of reciprocity.

this_court: The panel held that § 666 applies only to quid pro quo bribery, placing the Fifth Circuit with the First Circuit; the excerpts show the dissent from denial of rehearing en banc disagreed with the panel's reach but do not show the holding was changed.
quote: In doing so, the panel noted that it was putting our circuit on the short end of a “lopsided split” on this issue—joining the First Circuit against the Second, Sixth, Seventh, Eighth, and Eleventh Circuits.
cite: United States v. Hamilton, 62 F.4th 167 (5th Cir. 2023)
